home.h1: Your guests' upsell store, set up in minutes.
home.lead: Sell extras to your guests — early check-in, welcome packs, late checkout — and point them to the best of the neighbourhood. You keep every dollar of those sales.
home.micro: No card needed to start. You keep 100% of guest sales.
home.whatLead: Every property gets a store link. Guests open it and find the extras and local tips you want them to see.
home.storeBody: Offer paid extras directly to your guests. Stripe payments go straight to your bank account. Hostie Hub does not take a cut.
home.guideBody: Local restaurants, cafes and experiences can appear for your property's area. Guests discover the neighbourhood before they arrive.
home.hostsLead: Then a monthly subscription per property. You keep 100% of guest sales.
home.howLead: Paste your listing link, confirm the property, and add only the extras you want.
home.s1b: No card. Your first month is free.

home.s3b: Paste it into your guest messages on Airbnb, Booking.com or your PMS.
home.f1b: One stay or fifty. Each property can have its own guest store.
home.f2b: Connect Stripe once. Guest payments land in your account, with no platform fee.
home.f3b: Subscribe your Google or Apple calendar to see every order.
home.f4b: Add cleaners, co-hosts and managers with their own login.

home.partnersLead: This price is for local businesses, not hosts. Restaurants, tours, photographers and shops can be featured on host stores.
home.partnerLead: List your business, add an offer, and reach guests staying nearby.
home.partnerSuffix: per listing per month, after 3 months free
home.whyBody: First month free, then a simple monthly subscription. Hosts keep 100% of their guest sales. No card needed to start. Local businesses pay separately to be featured.
home.finalTitle: Open a store your guests will actually use.
home.finalLead: Bring your listing link. We'll help you fill the store — and we won't add a single product until you press Add.

terms.trial: Every new host account includes a 30-day free month. No credit card is required to start.
terms.paid: After the free month, the host plan is a monthly subscription per property. 1–2 properties are $10 each, 3–10 are $8 each, and 11 or more are $6 each. Every property is billed at the rate of the tier you reach.
terms.noFee: Hostie Hub takes no commission and no platform fee on guest sales. Hosts keep 100% of those sales. Guest payments are processed by Stripe Connect into the host's own Stripe account.
terms.refund: Subscription payments are not refunded once a paid month has started, because the free month is the time to decide. Guest-order refunds are between the host and the guest.
terms.cancel: You can cancel the monthly subscription at any time. The store stays available until the end of the period already paid.
